chapter: Learning drums, WPA band and dance halls
title: Drummers Rod, Buck Rogers and Emmett Rogers; left-handed drumming
summary: Talk of drummers who died, and of Monk and Emmett Rogers setting up and playing left-handed.

I'm going to come out to the famous door and play with the Dukes, you know. I said, what happened to Rod? I said, heart attack. Quiet, when I heard that. I said, man, I'm working to make it, man. Well, Emmett Rogers was different from Buck, huh?
Yeah, Emmett was out. Emmett played left hand drums, see. Yeah.
Snatsy Rogers. Snatsy Rogers. Emmett played left hand like Monk, you know. That's why he comes to it.
Except Monk played left, Monk played like this, you know. Monk played this drum on the left side, see. I put mine over here, see. Monk played over here. You play left footed or right footed? Me?
Right foot. Right foot and left handed. I play this, see.
